title: Cross-check solvers on one model
heading: In the Runner, Four Solvers Solve GridCap's Selection Model to the Same Optimum
cases: a solver whose optimal objective is far from the others' is named, and the agreeing ones are not
an objective too high is as suspect as one too low
one wild value does not drag the reference and make the agreeing solvers look wrong
a run that stopped at a limit is neither judged nor used to set the reference
a difference no larger than the tolerance is not suspect
